'''Tiina''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] and the [[Queen/Legends|queen]] of [[Arrochar]] during the early [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Her [[Marriage/Legends|husband]] was [[King/Legends|King]] [[Tolar]], and their son was [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Kaspar]]. A few months after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], it was agreed that Kaspar would marry [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Princess Leia]], in return the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] would be able to establish a new homebase on Arrochar. Later on Tolar and Tiina were [[Death/Legends|murdered]] on orders of the leader of the [[Arrocharian militia|Arrochar Militia]], who planned to deliver the Rebels to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].
